title: Voyah Radio 0.3.10
notes:
- Updated player and station catalogue layouts for wide and compact head-unit displays, with scrolling station tabs on narrow screens.
- Separate Mazda EZ-6 build with its own app ID (`app.mazdaez6radio`) and in-app update asset.

Use **MazdaEZ6Radio-v0.3.10.apk** on the Mazda EZ-6 and **VoyahRadio-v0.3.10.apk** on Voyah.
